292: 	}
293: 
294: 	result := resolver.ApplyOperation(existingDist, op)
295: 
296: 	if result == nil {
297: 		// delete
298: 		_, _ = dc.local.Delete(ctx, op.DocumentID)
299: 	} else if result.Deleted {
300: 		_, _ = dc.local.Delete(ctx, op.DocumentID)
301: 	} else {
302: 		// upsert
303: 		_, _ = dc.local.Insert(ctx, resolver.ToRegular(result))
304: 	}
305: 
306: 	// merge vector
307: 	if dc.networkID != "" {

316: 	}

318: 	if syncState.SyncInProgress {

320: 	}
321: 	syncState.SyncInProgress = true
322: 
323: 	_ = dc.network.BroadcastMessage(dc.networkID, typ.ProtocolMessage{Type: typ.MsgSyncRequest, NetworkID: dc.networkID, SenderID: dc.network.GetPeerID(), Timestamp: time.Now().UnixMilli(), Payload: map[string]interface{}{"collection": dc.Name, "vector": syncState.LocalVector}})
324: 
325: 	// Clear flag after timeout
326: 	go func() {
327: 		time.Sleep(10 * time.Second)
328: 		syncState.SyncInProgress = false
329: 	}()
330: 
331: 	return nil
332: }

334: func (dc *DistributedCollection) handleSyncRequest(msg typ.ProtocolMessage) {
335: 	payload, _ := msg.Payload.(map[string]interface{})
336: 	remoteVector, _ := payload["vector"].(map[string]interface{})
337: 
338: 	// convert remoteVector into VectorClock
339: 	rv := make(clock.VectorClock)
340: 	for k, v := range remoteVector {
341: 		switch val := v.(type) {
342: 		case float64:
343: 			rv[k] = int64(val)
344: 		case int64:
345: 			rv[k] = val
346: 		}
347: 	}
348: 
349: 	// find missing ops
350: 	missing := make([]typ.CRDTOperation, 0)
351: 	for _, op := range dc.operationLog {
352: 		remoteClock := int64(0)
353: 		if vv, ok := rv[op.PeerID]; ok {
354: 			remoteClock = vv
355: 		}
356: 		opClock := int64(0)
357: 		if vv, ok := op.Vector[op.PeerID]; ok {
358: 			opClock = vv
359: 		}
360: 		if opClock > remoteClock {
361: 			missing = append(missing, op)
362: 		}
363: 	}
364: 
365: 	_ = dc.network.SendToPeer(msg.SenderID, dc.networkID, typ.ProtocolMessage{Type: typ.MsgSyncResponse, NetworkID: dc.networkID, SenderID: dc.network.GetPeerID(), Timestamp: time.Now().UnixMilli(), Payload: map[string]interface{}{"collection": dc.Name, "operations": missing, "vector": dc.syncStates[dc.networkID].LocalVector}})
366: }

371: 
372: 	for _, oi := range opsIface {
373: 		b, _ := jsonMarshal(oi)
374: 		var op typ.CRDTOperation
375: 		_ = jsonUnmarshal(b, &op)
376: 		dc.handleRemoteOperation(op)
377: 	}
378: 
379: 	if dc.networkID != "" {
380: 		syncState := dc.syncStates[dc.networkID]
381: 		syncState.SyncInProgress = false
382: 		syncState.LastSync = time.Now()
383: 	}
384: }
